title: Bi-allelic missense variants in human GPN2 result in Perrault syndrome.

verified.what_i_actually_checked: Read the full open-access text (a short letter). Listed the Dryad dataset via its API: 3 tiny CSVs (Table_1 2,151 bytes, Table_2 1,996 bytes, Table_3 593 bytes), 2 TIFF figures and a README, 5.1 MB in total. File downloads through the Dryad API returned 401 (unauthorized), so I did not open the CSVs; at ~2 KB each they can only hold a few dozen rows.
verified.what_came_from_paper_text_only: 3 families, 13 affected individuals, 2 homozygous GPN2 missense variants (p.His121Gln, p.Asn222Asp), LOD (linkage) score 6.03, CADD scores 20.7 and 23.8, mouse inner-ear RNAscope images. Per the text, the Dryad tables hold clinical and biochemical details for the affected individuals.

a1_downloadable.note: Dryad record is public (the CSVs are listed), but the API download returned 401; the web download is probably open. Not opened.

a2_label_is_a_column.note: No ML label exists. The tables are per-patient clinical descriptions (hearing loss, hormone levels) for 13 people, not a measured outcome across many items. Judged from file sizes and the paper text.

a3_inputs_present.note: Only 2 variants in 1 gene; no feature matrix. Exome data was not deposited (none found in the text or by NCBI linking).

a5_enough_rows.note: 13 affected individuals and 2 variants, per the paper; the CSVs total about 4.7 KB. Far below the 400-row minimum.

a8_label_provenance.note: No label to trace. The only per-variant scores are CADD (a variant-effect predictor) outputs, which are model predictions.

honest_claim_h3: No model claim is possible: the dataset is two missense variants in one gene from 13 patients in three families.

plain_idea.one_liner: Use protein changes to predict whether a missense variant in this gene causes Perrault syndrome.
plain_idea.train_on: Two disease variants in GPN2 from 13 patients. Number of usable labelled examples: 2.
plain_idea.predict: Whether a variant is disease-causing, taken from family segregation and linkage analysis in this paper.
plain_idea.why_worthwhile: Nothing a model could learn from 2 variants; the paper's value is a new gene-disease link for clinical geneticists, not a dataset.

ml_idea: None viable. A single-gene rare-disease case report (3 families, 2 variants) gives no training set; at most the two variants could be test cases for an existing variant-effect predictor.

effort.compute_note: Not estimated; no ML task exists.
effort.cheapest_killing_check: Count the labelled variants: 2 (from the paper text). That kills it.

verdict_reason: Rare-disease gene-discovery letter: 13 patients, 2 missense variants, a few-KB clinical table. No label column and nowhere near enough rows (A2, A5 fail).
